strongest_angle: Explain Colorado's expanded housing protections under House Bill 25-1168 and the Attorney General's advisory targeting landlord compliance.

key_facts.fact: Colorado Attorney General Phil Weiser issued a public advisory on October 6, 2026, reminding landlords of expanded housing protections for victim-survivors of domestic violence under House Bill 25-1168.
House Bill 25-1168 expanded current legal exceptions and protections against unlawful detention and eviction to include victims of unlawful sexual behavior and stalking alongside domestic violence.

The Division of Real Estate summary shows House Bill 25-1168 was signed and became effective on May 22, 2025, with primary sponsors including Representative Mandy Lindsay, Representative Cecelia Espenoza, and Senator Mike Weissman.
